{{recipe}}

This is a very simple and popular '''fruit salad'''. Any fruit can be used.

==Ingredients==

* [[Cookbook:Apple|Apples]]
* [[Cookbook:Banana|Bananas]]
* [[Cookbook:Orange|Oranges]]
* [[Cookbook:Maraschino Cherry|Maraschino cherries]]
* [[Cookbook:Orange Juice|Orange juice]]

==Procedure==
#Peel the apples and bananas. [[Cookbook:Dice|Dice]] them into small pieces.
#Peel and separate the orange sections. Cut sections into smaller pieces if desired. 
#Cut the cherries into halves or quarters, depending on the size. Pour a bit of the cherry juice in bowl.
#Mix everything together, and add orange juice as desired.
#If desired, refrigerate prior to serving.

==Notes, tips, and variations==

* This recipe has been handed down for more than 5 generations and is very quenching and satisfying as a snack or dessert.
